description:
Spade | Multiple Engineering, AI/ML Data Science, and Revenue roles| HYBRID NYC or REMOTE (US/CAN) | $135-240K+ (depending on role/level) + equity Spade helps banks and fintechs unlock the value in their own transaction data. We're looking for extraordinary builders to play a foundational role in a company designed for scale: - Senior Platform Security Engineer (Remote US/CAN or NYC)

 - Backend Engineer (Remote US/CAN or NYC)

 - Fullstack Engineer (NYC)

 - Data Scientist - AI/ML (NYC)

 - Product Performance Analyst (NYC)

 - Account Executive - Enterprise, Fintech (NYC)

 - Product Marketing Manager (NYC)
 

We're well-funded by top investors (YC/a16z/OAK), and known for building intentional, inclusive culture. We offer competitive compensation (salary + equity) and comprehensive benefits. NYC roles are hybrid (2 days/week in our dog-friendly Flatiron office). If interested, please apply here ( https://spade.com/careers/ ) and mention this post.
